# Ny uge med fokus på amerikansk inflation og arbejdsmarked

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode previews a week focused on US PCE inflation, Nonfarm Payrolls and earnings from Micron and Nike, plus the Oura IPO. Guest Peter Garnry (Gæsta Capital) warns about AI capex now being more than half debt-financed, naming Oracle and CoreWeave as canaries. He stays undecided on Nike, which trades at depressed multiples, and prefers mining-equipment suppliers (Sandvik, Metso, Weir), logistics subcontractors and physical AI. The panel is broadly bearish on consumer stocks and cautious on Better Collective after its Brazil-driven guidance cut and on DSV's downtrend.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ BETCO — Better Collective | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down 20% after the Brazil ban and guidance withdrawal; repeated misses and founder selling; no insider buying.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars notes a pattern of disappointments (May and October 2024, now Brazil), sideways trading between 80 and 100 DKK, and founders selling. He expects investors to stay passive medium term. Michelle flags regulatory risk as a structural feature of betting companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- Insider buying of size
- Clarity or a favourable outcome on Brazilian regulation
- Guidance reinstated

> *"Så jeg tror, at de folk er lidt passive på den mellemlange bane her."*

---

### 🟠 NKE — Nike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Peter is studying the case: crisis-low sales multiple, and margins back to average could nearly double earnings. He is undecided; co-hosts are negative.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees a possible once-in-a-lifetime entry if the brand is intact. He wants Thursday's report to show sales turning, cleaner inventory and better margins, and values the insider CEO Elliot Hill. Risks are China losses to Anta and Li Ning, weakness with women and young buyers, tariffs and fast fashion. He admits he is far from a conclusion.

#### Sell Triggers

- Sales fail to turn
- Continued margin pressure
- Inventory problems persist
- Management sounds without a plan on the call

> *"Jeg skal straks anerkende her, at vi kigger på casen og er slet ikke i mål med at være afklaret på noget som helst."*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron Technology | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Peter expects a beat on strong momentum; the focus is memory-price commentary. Cyclical risk and uncertain normalised earnings.

#### Reasoning

Memory is a commodity market at a possible cyclical peak with heavy capacity additions. Low P/E ratios may mislead, and guidance on memory pricing is key.

#### Sell Triggers

- Weak memory-price outlook
- Signs of a cycle peak or capacity glut

> *"Jeg vil ikke være overrasket, hvis de faktisk slår forventningerne"*

---

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Credit concerns and a sharp FCF deterioration; the canary for the now debt-financed AI buildout.

#### Reasoning

Peter notes Q2 was the first quarter in which more than half of AI capex was debt-financed. Oracle sits at the weak end of investment-grade issuers, so any domino effect would show there first. Its free cash flow is collapsing after 30 years without losses.

#### Sell Triggers

- Widening credit spreads on Oracle debt
- Further FCF deterioration

> *"det er Oracle, du skal holde øje med, du skal holde øje med CoreWeave"*

---

### 🟠 WEIR — Weir Group | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Mining-equipment supplier with high aftermarket service revenue, giving exposure to a multi-year copper and rare-earth boom.

#### Reasoning

Peter prefers the equipment and service part of the mining value chain over the miners themselves, for stable, lower-risk exposure to a long minerals boom.

#### Sell Triggers

- Mining capex boom fades

> *"Weir i England, et engelsk aktie, giver ret ren eksponering"*

---

### 🟠 SAND — Sandvik | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Named as a mining-equipment and aftermarket play on the minerals boom.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as Weir: stable service revenue from equipment sold to mines, benefiting from a copper and rare-earth shortage for years ahead.

#### Sell Triggers

- Mining capex slowdown

> *"Så du har sådan nogle selskaber som Sandvik, Metso i Finland"*

---

### 🟠 METSO — Metso | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Finnish mining-equipment supplier in Peter's mining value-chain theme.

#### Reasoning

Aftermarket-heavy supplier to mines, offering lower-risk exposure to a structural minerals boom.

#### Sell Triggers

- Mining capex slowdown

> *"Så du har sådan nogle selskaber som Sandvik, Metso i Finland"*

---

### ⛔ DSV — DSV | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lars stays on the sidelines while it is in a downtrend; Peter prefers logistics subcontractors given DSV's integration risk.

#### Reasoning

Lars wants an upward trend before entering and sees possible support at 1,100. Peter respects the management but sees integration and culture risk and more attractive return profiles among suppliers to the logistics sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- Breaks out of the falling trend into an uptrend
- Integration success

> *"så jeg stiller mig på sidelinjen og skal ikke være den første, der går ud på isen"*

---

### 🟠 NTG — Nordic Transport Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Lars sees better momentum than DSV; it has stopped at old resistance around 280.

#### Reasoning

The relative trend is stronger, but it needs European and German activity to pick up to break through resistance.

#### Sell Triggers

- Rejected at 280 resistance
- European freight stays weak

> *"NTG er stoppet op her ved 280, og det er det gamle modstandsniveau"*

---

### 🟠 DFDS — DFDS | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Lars, who owns it, sees more tailwind and better price action than DSV.

#### Reasoning

Improved share-price development relative to Danish logistics peers. Lars discloses his own holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- Tailwind fades
- European activity stalls

> *"jeg skal sige, jeg er selv DFDS derhjemme"*

---

### 🟡 ASML — ASML | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Held by Peter's fund as a chip-value-chain position that wins regardless of which chipmaker wins.

#### Reasoning

The guest prefers bottleneck positions over commodity memory makers.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI and semiconductor capex downturn

> *"Nej, vi ligger med ASML i den del af vidikæden."*

---

### 🟡 CELH — Celsius | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The only pure consumer stock in Peter's fund; world No. 3 energy-drink brand.

#### Reasoning

The guest holds it despite being negative on the wider consumer sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- Consumer weakness hits the brand

> *"Vi har faktisk kun én, altså en rendyrket forbrug-aktie i vores selskab, som er et Celsius"*

---

### ⛔ CARL-B — Carlsberg | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Brewers have stalled; it fell from 950 to 850 and the panel sees no reason to buy.

#### Reasoning

A weak consumer and cost pressures weigh on consumer staples. The host and panel are negative on consumer stocks in the current macro backdrop.

#### Sell Triggers

- Consumer recovery
- Easing input costs

> *"Jeg havde drømt, at Carlsberg skulle i 1000."*

---

### 🟠 PNDORA — Pandora | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars sees it as perhaps the only Danish consumer name still heading up as silver prices stabilise.

#### Reasoning

Relative strength within a weak consumer sector, helped by easing silver costs.

#### Sell Triggers

- Silver price spike
- Consumer slowdown

> *"Måske den eneste, der er lidt på vej, stadigvæk opad, det er Pandora"*

---
